//ConnectionStrings: specs/018-cluster-secret-store FR-001/FR-009: no credential is committed here. Running via docker-compose needs no action (ConnectionStrings__OrdersDb is already injected — docker-compose.yml). Running `dotnet run` directly, set your own local secret once: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:OrdersDb" "Server=localhost,14333;Database=orders;User Id=sa;Password=<your local MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD, see .env.example>;TrustServerCertificate=True;Connect Timeout=3;ConnectRetryCount=0" --project services/orders/src/Orders.Api. Without it, the service fails fast at startup (shared/ServiceDefaults/RequiredSecretsValidation.cs) instead of starting with no database.
